name: Contested Ground
text: The ground inside your reach belongs to you until somebody takes it from you. Your melee reach extends 5ft for Opportunity Attacks. An enemy that begins its turn within your melee reach must spend half its movement to leave that reach.

name: Forward Pressure
text: You build control by pressing, not by waiting to be pressed. The first time each turn that you move at least 10ft and then deal damage with a melee attack, you gain 1 Momentum.

name: Hold the Line
text: You decide where the line runs, and crossing it is not their decision to make. As a Reaction when an enemy moves through your space or out of your melee reach, spend 1 Momentum. That enemy must succeed on a Vigor Save or its movement ends at once, and it cannot move again until the start of its next turn. On a success it completes the movement but Downgrades its Impact Die until the end of its next turn.

name: Open the Lane
text: You do not go around a formation. For 1 AP, 1 Momentum, and 1 Vigor Point, move up to your Speed in a straight line, passing through enemy spaces and provoking no Opportunity Attacks. Push every enemy you pass 10ft to either side. An enemy pushed into another creature or a solid obstacle must succeed on a Vigor Save or be knocked Prone.

name: Breach Run
text: You pick the thickest part of their line and run at it. For 1 AP and 1 Vigor Point, move up to your Speed in a straight line without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then make one melee attack against each of up to three enemies whose space you passed through or moved adjacent to. Add one Vigor Die to the Impact Roll of any of those attacks made against a Prone enemy.

name: Phalanx Formation
text: A shield wall of two is still a shield wall. For 1 AP and 1 Momentum, choose one ally within 5ft of you. Until the start of your next turn, any enemy attacking you or that ally Downgrades its Impact Die unless it is adjacent to both of you.

name: Through the Gap
text: Every enemy you put on the ground is a door standing open. When you knock an enemy Prone, one ally who can see it may immediately move up to 10ft toward that enemy, provoking no Opportunity Attacks. This happens once per turn, however many enemies you fell.

name: Thunderclap Step
text: Requires any two Linebreaker Majors. You come out of a stride and put the rest of it into the ground. For 1 AP, 2 Momentum, and 1 Vigor Point, roll your Vigor Die against the Vigor Defense of every enemy within 10ft. On a hit the target takes that damage, is knocked Prone, and has its Vigor Defense Sundered until the end of your next turn. On a Glancing Blow only the Sunder applies.

name: Unstoppable Advance
text: The line is something other people believe in. You ignore difficult terrain, and you cannot be knocked Prone, Slowed, or moved against your will. When a melee attack you make results in a Glancing Blow, spend 1 Momentum and that enemy must succeed on a Vigor Save or be knocked Prone.
